result.title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for post-training large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory overhead during rollout generation, which motivates low-precision rollout for efficient RL training. However, existing FP4 RL methods suffer from a key limitation: they primarily optimize quantization accuracy on the training and rollout paths independently rather than directly reducing the discrepancy between the two quantized execution paths. In this work, we propose TRACE (Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE), an FP4 quantization framework for RL training of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models that addresses the limitation of existing FP4 RL methods. TRACE incorporates rollout-guided quantization-aware training that uses rollout-side quantization outcomes to guide training-side FP4 rounding decisions, directly reducing train-rollout discrepancy. Moreover, TRACE adopts an efficient quantization-information caching scheme that selectively retains mantissa and scale information from deeper layers to reduce the storage and communication overhead introduced by rollout guidance. We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4xrollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.

AI.brief_summary: TRACE 针对 MoE 语言模型 RL 训练中的 rollout 开销，提出用 rollout 侧量化结果引导训练侧 FP4 舍入决策的量化感知训练，并缓存深层 mantissa 与 scale 信息以降低存储通信开销，在四类 MoE 模型上验证 FP4 rollout 可接近 BF16 的 RL 表现并加速至 5.4 倍。
AI.relevance_reason: 主题为 RL 训练效率与低精度量化，并非视觉或多模态 latent 推理；但其「训练路径与 rollout 路径量化对齐」及深层量化信息选择性缓存，可能为 LVR 中 rollout 生成状态与训练监督的一致性、以及 latent/缓存信息取舍提供方法线索，可供核查。
